detailed_descriptions.en: Make your city feel connected with the Creator Pack ‘City Stations’. Designed by community creator ‘BadPeanut’, this pack expands the variety of transit infrastructure available for your metropolis. Featuring a selection of stations for your Bus, Train, Tram, and Subway networks, the pack introduces new landmarks for your citizens and lays the foundation for a transport system that is both efficient and beautiful. Included in ‘City Stations’ by ‘BadPeanut’: 22 Service Buildings: Expand your city transport network with a range of new, compact depots and rail yards, a selection of stations with alternating designs, and 4 landmark stations. These buildings feature modern designs and have upgrades that form multi-modal transport hubs. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Make your city feel connected with the Creator Pack ‘City Stations’. Designed by community creator ‘BadPeanut’, this pack expands the variety of transit infrastructure available for your metropolis. Featuring a selection of stations for your Bus, Train, Tram, and Subway networks, the pack introduces new landmarks for your citizens and lays the foundation for a transport system that is both efficient and beautiful.

Included in ‘City Stations’ by ‘BadPeanut’: 

22 Service Buildings: 

Expand your city transport network with a range of new, compact depots and rail yards, a selection of stations with alternating designs, and 4 landmark stations. These buildings feature modern designs and have upgrades that form multi-modal transport hubs.

Buildings: 

  • Compact Bus Depot

  • Compact Rail Yard

  • Compact Refurbished Tram Depot

  • Compact Subway Yard

  • Small City Bus Station

  • Large City Bus Station

  • City Center Bus Station

  • Sunken Bypass Train Station

  • Elevated Bypass Train Station

  • City Central Train Station

  • Small Tram Plaza

  • Large Tram Plaza

  • Tram Terminal Plaza

  • Small Subway Plaza

  • Elevated Bypass Subway Station

  • Sunken Subway Park

  • Small Pedestrian Overpass

  • Medium Pedestrian Overpass

  • Large Pedestrian Overpass

  • Extra Large Pedestrian Overpass

20 Service Upgrades: 

Expand and diversify the service buildings included in this pack with a range of useful service upgrades, found across the different depots, stations and landmark stations. Each upgrade offers extra capacity, extra functionality or an effect bonus to your city.

14 Props:

Decorate and customize your city and its transit with a range of new props. Whether a modern Pavilion to shelter your citizens, a Clock Tower that doubles as the centerpiece of a roundabout or architectural tram and bus stop shelters with extra comfort for your passengers.
